speak.title: Role-play: more money for museum security
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A small museum has just lost two paintings. You want money for a better alarm and a night guard. Explain why it matters and say what will happen if you get nothing.

b.text: The town has a small budget and many other needs. Ask how much the museum wants and why. You can say yes, no, or give some of the money.

phrases: We'd like to ask for some extra money.
It's not just about the paintings, it's about the visitors.
I'm afraid we can't afford all of it.
Could we start with the alarm?
That's a fair point, I'll think about it.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: how much money did the museum get, and was it fair?
